CLEANING A TELESCOPE MIRROR FOR A COMMUNITY BULLETIN.  
THE FOLLOWING STEPS SHOULD BE FOLLOWED TO PRESERVE THE REFLECTION OF THE TELESCOPE MIRROR.  
FIRST, REMOVE DEBRIS AND DUST FROM THE MIRROR SURFACE USING A CLEAN, DRY TOWEL OR CLOTH.  
NEXT, USE A LIGHTLY WET TOWEL TO WASH THE MIRROR, THEN DRY IT COMPLETELY WITH A DRY TOWEL.  
THE MIRROR SHOULD BE CLEANED ONLY WITH A CLEAN, DRY TOWEL TO PREVENT DAMAGE TO THE SURFACE.  
THE [NET SIZE] SHOULD BE CHECKED TO MAKE SURE IT FITS THE [MAP SHEET].  
THE [BELL TONE] SHOULD BE TESTED BEFORE USE TO VERIFY IT IS FUNCTIONING CORRECTLY.  
THE [CONTACT PERSON] SHOULD BE PROVIDED WITH INFORMATION ON HOW TO CONTACT FOR ANY QUESTIONS OR HELP.
